Cloud and ML hiring, senior / lead (2024)

caveats: BLS figures are US occupations, not Kenya, and not backend-only.
BLS wage percentiles are not junior/mid/senior bands and not offers for Kenya-based remote workers.
BLS lists developers (1,717,800) separately from developers plus QA/testers (1,905,400; 106,100 openings a year including replacements). Do not mix the two.
HackerRank measures test invites on its own platform: a direction signal, not hiring volume.
Vendor totals (240,303 backend postings, 18,482 weekly, 99,173 Python) were not independently verifiable and stay withdrawn. This site counts only what its own live feeds return.
